app_store.name: Kinetix: AI Code Canvas
app_store.subtitle: Fast Artifacts & Reasoning
app_store.promotional_text: Build interactive components and execute code with live token telemetry and zero rate-limit lockouts.
app_store.description:
Kinetix is an unconstrained conversational AI workspace built for software engineers, designers, and technical builders.

Craft interactive HTML, SVG, and code components in a real-time split-screen canvas while watching deep reasoning unfold.

What makes Kinetix different:
- Interactive Artifacts: Inspect and execute web components in an isolated sandboxed runner with version switching and source code export.
- Transparent Token Telemetry: Monitor live token counts on every prompt. Never wonder why your usage changed.
- BYOK Overflow Fallback: Connect your own API keys when monthly limits run low so your coding flow never stops.
- Local Model Support: Route sensitive corporate tasks directly to local Ollama instances running on your machine for complete privacy.
- Project Knowledge Hub: Attach architectural specs and codebases with visual context budget meters.

Developer tier is available at no cost. Pro subscription is $20 a month.
app_store.whats_new: Initial release of Kinetix with interactive Artifacts canvas, deep reasoning engine, and live token telemetry.
